name: Flag Rush
hook: Race through the course. First to the flag wins.
how: Run, jump, ride moving platforms and bounce off springs past spikes and pits. Land on a rival's head to make them stumble, and grab the flag before anyone else.
controls: Arrow keys or A/D and Space, or on-screen ◀ ▶ and Jump
uses: The players who won the most races.
The host's browser runs the countdown, calls the winner and starts the next race; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots race you and fill the start line until enough people join.
Every runner, jump and bonk shows up for everyone at once, on the same course.
ideas: Add a speed pad that makes you run twice as fast
Make the course a lava cave with falling rocks
Add a new course piece with a seesaw
